name: notaio-chianese-calcoli
description: Six calculators for Italy from a notary's office: property purchase taxes, cadastral value, usufruct and bare ownership, heirs' shares, inheritance and gift tax, selling versus gifting a home.

capabilities: Taxes on buying real estate in Italy: homes, land, offices, shops, warehouses
Cadastral value from cadastral income, for one property or a whole cadastral record
Value of usufruct and bare ownership by age
Who inherits under Italian law, and in what shares
Italian inheritance tax and gift tax by kinship
Taxes on selling versus gifting a home to a relative
defaultPrompt: How much tax will I pay buying a €200,000 first home in Italy from a private seller? Cadastral income is €900.
My father died in Italy without a will, leaving his wife and three children. Who inherits, and in what shares?
In Italy, is it cheaper in taxes to sell or to gift my flat to my son? Cadastral income €1,000, value €150,000.

positive.description: Purchase taxes on a first home bought from a private seller
positive.prompt: I am buying a home in Italy from a private seller for €200,000 as my first home. The cadastral income is €900. How much tax will I pay?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls imposte_acquisto_immobile and reports €2,215 in taxes, itemised (registration tax €2,079), and says the notary's fee is not included. The tool also returns the total without first-home relief (€10,342); the assistant may or may not quote it.

positive.description: Shares of the heirs when there is no will
positive.prompt: My father died in Italy without a will. He leaves his wife and three children. How is the estate divided?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls quote_ereditarie and reports the spouse's share (1/3) and each child's share (2/9). The tool also returns the shares the law reserves to them; the assistant may or may not quote them.

positive.description: Selling versus gifting a home to a child
positive.prompt: I want to transfer my flat in Italy to my son. Cadastral income €1,000, value about €150,000, it would be his first home. Is it cheaper in taxes to sell it to him or to gift it?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls vendita_o_donazione and reports €2,443.60 in taxes for the sale and €763.40 for the gift, then the differences that are not about money, including that a buyer of a gifted home no longer risks having to return it.

positive.description: Value of bare ownership when the owner keeps the usufruct
positive.prompt: I was born on 10 March 1956 and my house in Italy is worth €200,000. If I transfer it on 15 October 2026 and keep the usufruct, what is the bare ownership worth?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls usufrutto_nuda_proprieta and reports usufruct €80,000 (40%) and bare ownership €120,000 (60%).

positive.description: Gift tax on a home given to a child
positive.prompt: I want to gift my son a home in Italy with a cadastral value of €200,000. How much tax is due?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls imposte_successione_donazione with operazione "donazione" and reports €6,371.40 in total: no gift tax, because the value is below the allowance for children, plus the taxes on the property.

negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in Milan this weekend?

negative.description: A tax these calculators do not cover
negative.prompt: How much IMU do I pay each year on my second home in Rome?

negative.description: Drafting a legal document is not a calculation
negative.prompt: Write my will leaving everything to my partner.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products and does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: six read-only calculators for real estate purchases, inheritance and gifts in Italy.
